name: University of Bern underground laboratory
notes: No official page of the laboratory was found; every statement comes from the ORPHEUS papers and reviews by the Bern group. The laboratory's position in Bern is not published in the sources read.

operator_text.note: Inferred: the paper's authors are at the Laboratory for High Energy Physics, University of Bern, and write 'our underground laboratory in Bern'.
operator_text.quote: The ORPHEUS dark matter detector is operating at our underground laboratory in Bern (70 m.w.e.).
operator_text.value: University of Bern (Laboratory for High Energy Physics)

summary.plain: A shallow underground laboratory of the University of Bern's Laboratory for High Energy Physics, with about 70 metres of water equivalent of cover; it hosted the ORPHEUS dark matter detector.
summary.technical: Shallow underground facility of the University of Bern (70 m.w.e.), used for low-background germanium measurements and for ORPHEUS; the cryostat had to be connected sideways because of limited vertical space, and an active muon veto was needed at this depth (arXiv:astro-ph/0404311).
